explanation: The child passthrough Start receives caller roots 0–3. Right Sort orders them 3,2,1,0; Right Limit keeps sorted positions 0 and 1, and Select chooses the second (Right Project) input, so Return items trace to caller roots 3 and 2. The parent Call output exposes pairedItem roots 0 and 1 for its two outputs, so both positional pairs mismatch despite equal payloads and successful execution.
